$comment: Machine-readable form of this template's PATTERNS.md. Engines live in knowledge/ENGINES.md; tone dials in knowledge/TONE.md. NOTHING here is measured below 40 seconds — see evidence_gap.
confidence: n=3, two from one channel, nothing measured below 40s

evidence_gap.note: The brief asks for max 30s. The best available short-form work from the modelled channels sits at 40-60s (the Shorts ceiling). Compression from 40s to 25s is INFERRED and untested — the template's first open question.

engines.note: Engine B (Effort/Payoff) was observed at 2:08 and again at 0:40 unchanged — engines are length-independent.

shapes.when: the subject is a felt problem
shapes.example: it's 3am, your code is broken, you have no idea where your kids are

shapes.when: the subject is a skill or a risk
shapes.example: if you want to get a job as a programmer you need to know Big O

anti_pattern.why: Signals that a fact is coming and gives the viewer a clean moment to leave. Zero of three studied shorts use it.
anti_pattern.ui_rule: Do not offer this as a template option — if the tool offers it, it will be used.

one_idea.anchor_ladder_is_not_an_exception: Big O teaches five complexity classes but ONE idea (cost grows differently for different work), on ONE object.
one_idea.anchor_rule: Establish the anchor within 2 seconds and never replace it. A second metaphor is the most expensive mistake available at this length.

image-led.note: the pictures argue, narration labels them (PolyMatter Target)

narration-led.note: visuals follow the words (both Fireship shorts)

visual_mode.note: Rate in short form is a function of the visual plan, not pacing taste. The Script step cannot resolve it — emit a word-budget RANGE and hand the mode to the Frames step. Guessing wrong by 2x is the difference between a clip that breathes and one nobody can follow.

derived_short_contract.applies_when: the clip is scoped from a mid-length script
rules: The clip must be COMPLETE on its own — a viewer who never clicks through has still received something
The withheld thing must be a DIFFERENT question, not the missing half of the one just closed
The pointer is explicit and last — a named thing that happened, then the link
The clip must not depend on the parent video's setup

anti_pattern.what: Cutting a segment from the middle of a long video, where the hook is a mid-argument sentence and the payoff was established minutes earlier.
anti_pattern.why_it_persists: It reads as complete to the person who made it and as noise to everyone else.

derived_short_contract.confidence: INFERRED from a single witness (PolyMatter, This is Not Target)

close.why: No room to re-describe at this length; the last beat buys memorability instead of insight.
close.joke_still_carries_info: BOGO sort is the punchline AND teaches the top of the complexity scale.
close.confidence: OBSERVED in 2 of 3, both from the same channel

ui_contract.derived_mode: pick the parent script, then the four contract checks as review items

not_validated: No engagement, retention or completion data. These are craft observations from work that appears to succeed; view counts are not evidence of craft.
